title: Haiti: Gang leader reportedly targeted in drone operation
summary: According to Haitian media, notorious gang leader Jimmy "Barbecue" Cherizier's Port-au-Prince home was targeted in a drone operation. Branding himself as an anti-elite revolutionary, "Barbecue" is accused of a wide range of crimes and is thought to have played a key role in the 2018 La Saline Massacre. #haiti #cherizier #gangviolence
